Hi Vanessa / Procurement team,

Following our onboarding earlier this year, our finance team has requested a formal update to Acme's vendor record: we are changing the remit-to bank account and the legal payee name. Details below:

- New legal name: Acme Plastics Inc. (effective immediately)

- New mailing address: 412 S. Harbor Rd, Suite 200, Wilmington, NC 28401

Tom —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the W-9/voided check. A few items we need to complete the vendor rekey: 

1) Completed vendor change request form (we use this internally to capture effective date and reason). I can send a fillable DocuSign if that helps.
2) Copy of the invoice remit clause showing the new legal name or a short letter on company letterhead confirming the legal entity change.
3) Confirmation whether the tax ID (EIN) changed with the legal name. If it changed, send a new W-9 (looks like one is attached but please confirm EIN).
4) Anything else required by your bank for ACH (some banks require a bank letter in addition to a voided check).

Operational notes:
- If the legal entity changed (Acme Components LLC -> Acme Plastics Inc.), we will create a new vendor record in our system and map outstanding POs to the new remit based on the effective date you provide.
- For PO routing: our AP team needs a confirmed effective date to determine which invoices hit which vendor record. If you want payments to start on invoices dated 12/01/2026, please state that explicitly on the vendor change form.

I can start the internal request once you return the completed form and confirm EIN. I'll loop in Karthik (AP) to review treasury/PO implications.

DocuSign vendor change: https://www.docusign.com/request/abcd-1234 (expires in 7 days)
Procurement ticket: https://jira.internal.redwood/browse/PROC-1189

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
